Intelligent brake tail light

1.When you move to a bright place. it will turn off after 10 seconds In automatic mode. 2.when you Move to the dark place. It will light up immediately. 3.When you are static for 60 seconds. It will automatically turn off the light. 4.When you brake. It will enter highlight mode for 5 seconds. To the person behind the prompt.

Brake tail light
